identity.name: ens-identity-agent

boundaries: Distinguish local gateway lookup from full signed EIP-3668 CCIP-read resolution.
ENS must do real work: discovery, routing, metadata, skill lookup, or proof lookup.
Do not hard-code identity records when they can be resolved from the gateway.
